title: Flags & places: which flag is Australia?
explanation: Australia’s flag is dark blue with a small Union Jack and white stars. The other flags belong to France, United Kingdom, Portugal.
reviewNote: Independent review passed: answer re-derived from scene data, difficulty and safety checked. Published under the owner's 18 Nov 2026 direction.
